title: Quickstart error messaging visuals: progressive retry & backoff flow
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design a set of quickstart and docs-focused visuals that explain and teach our users what to expect when the inference API encounters transient or enforced limits. The deliverables should include a compact hero graphic for the quickstart guide, a two-panel troubleshooting card for the console, and a sequence diagram illustrating retry/backoff behavior and recommended client settings. Visuals must be production-ready for docs and small enough to fit on the quickstart landing without harming scanability.
acceptance_criteria: Hero graphic for quickstart that communicates graceful degradation and automatic retries (SVG + PNG export)
Doc troubleshooting card with three compact states: throttled (soft limit), timed-out, and persistent error with suggested next steps
Sequence diagram (annotated) that shows request -> server throttling -> client exponential backoff -> fallback to cached model/variant
Accessible color palette and iconography following Redwood brand (WCAG AA contrast for text in all graphics)
Figma file linked with named frames and export presets; console-ready 600x360 and 1200x720 versions exported
notes: 2025-02-15: Kickoff meeting with PM and Eng. Agreed scope: quickstart hero, troubleshooting card, sequence diagram. Liam assigned to art and interaction specs.
2025-02-18: Collected telemetry from Eng (sample 429 and 504 distributions) to shape messaging frequency and severity. Decision: prioritize 429 (throttling) and 504 (upstream timeout) narratives.

2025-02-22: Early sketches posted in Figma. PM prefers phrasing 'automatic backoff' rather than 'retry' for end-user docs; choose neutral wording in hero and add technical note in troubleshooting card.
2025-02-25: Accessibility pass—adjusted palette to meet AA for body copy over icon backgrounds. Need Eng to confirm console CSS variables for dark mode adaptation.
2025-02-28: Internal review with Docs — request for shorter alt text and an additional small inline GIF demonstrating retry timeline. GIF estimated as follow-up subtask.
review_feedback: Docs team: simplify copy lines to two sentences max; include explicit client code snippet reference for backoff headers
Engineering (runtime): prefer showing 'soft throttle' label instead of hard 'rate limit' in user-facing visuals to avoid legal confusion
PM: ensure troubleshooting card links to billing/usage dashboard and plan upgrade CTA
decisions: Use progressive disclosure: hero explains concept at high level, troubleshooting card provides actionable steps and links to code examples
Visual metaphor: use an adjustable 'throughput dial' icon to represent load rather than repeating numeric rate limits
Add small timeline GIF to docs page to show exponential backoff timings (client-visible) — will be a separate minor asset task
next_steps: Finalize Figma frames based on feedback (target 2025-03-03)
Export hero + card assets and handoff spec to Eng and Docs (2025-03-05)
Create GIF timeline asset and small code snippet for the docs quickstart (follow-up ticket DES-8795)
